scope: Answer from current public manuals only. No account data, tool writes or order placement.

fit.finding: Compare with keyword search. Proceed only if correct revision retrieval improves in the agreed pilot.

architecture.finding: Standard harness with a private Search connection; all published documents share one public audience.

identity.finding: Only approved publishers can write to the index. Test exclusion of an unpublished draft.

quality.finding: Require zero withdrawn references and at least 95 percent supported answers on the frozen manual fixtures.

operations.finding: Track citation success and index lag. Suspend the source when withdrawals cannot be verified.

cost.finding: Track Studio credits per supported answer and Search capacity including idle and rebuild hours. Alert at 80 percent of budget.

grounding.finding: Every chunk carries its manual revision and URL. Empty or superseded evidence produces no answer.
